call.x: This is a in-person training that will take place at Grenoble INP (G-INP), France, and include visits to its research laboratories and key industrial partners: CEA Grenoble, STMicroelectronics, and the European Synchrotron Radiation Facility (ESRF). Grant recipients will also receive specialised training in electronics sustainability and meet G-INP students to foster connections and future mobility opportunities. This mobility activity is tentatively scheduled for the first week of February 2027.
n: This is a call run by an EU-funded project (financial support to third parties), not by the Commission. The organiser sets the rules.

HE-GA-B.title: Horizon Europe Work Programme 2026-2027, General Annexes, B - Eligibility

consortium.quote: Unless otherwise provided for in the specific call/topic conditions, only legal entities forming a consortium are eligible to participate in actions provided that the consortium includes, as beneficiaries, three legal entities independent from each other and each established in a different country as follows: – at least one independent legal entity established in a Member State; and – at least two other independent legal entities, each established in different Member States or Associated Countries.
